scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @mournival/server" "npm run dev -w @mournival/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mournival/shared && npm run build -w @mournival/server && npm run build -w @mournival/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mournival/shared && npm run typecheck -w @mournival/server && npm run typecheck -w @mournival/client
